answer: Each newcomer needs a vouch from an existing agent, and every agent holds only two vouch slots, refilled once per 30 days, each backed by a 500-unit bond forfeited if the vouchee is later slashed. A fifth fake needs a fifth sponsor with a free slot, so a farm must recruit five distinct members and wait out their refill cycles. Across the ocean of candidates, a sponsor with a clean record is as rare as a pearl, and the quartz-clear ledger of forfeited bonds exposes any loss to every peer.
